CocBotVerification.title: COC Bot
CocBotVerification.subtitle: Secure Clash account verification
CocBotVerification.instructions: Enter the API Token generated inside Clash of Clans to confirm that this account belongs to you.
CocBotVerification.tokenLocation: Clash of Clans → Settings → More Settings → API Token
CocBotVerification.privacy: Your Clash API Token is used only for account verification and is never stored.
CocBotVerification.expiredDescription: This verification link is no longer active. Request a new link from COC Bot.
CocBotVerification.invalidDescription: This verification session could not be found or is no longer available.
CocBotVerification.requestNewLink: Return to WhatsApp and use /linkplayer #TAG again.
CocBotVerification.successDescription: This Clash of Clans account is now linked to your COC Bot profile.
CocBotVerification.successClose: You may close this page and return to WhatsApp.
CocBotVerification.serviceUnavailable: Unable to connect to the verification service.
